app.name: FoundBack
app.tagline: Lost something? Found something? Get it back to its owner, safely.
app.disclaimer: FoundBack connects people. Meet only in safe public places.

header.countryExplainBody: Items, maps, matches, safe places and guidance on FoundBack are limited to your country, so everything you see is nearby and relevant. You can only claim items in {{country}}.
header.countryExplainChange: Moved to another country? You can change it in Settings.

language.title: Choose your language
language.partial: Partly translated, missing text shows in English

signIn.title: Sign in to FoundBack
signIn.subtitle: Continue with Google, or use your email and a password.
signIn.resendIn: You can request a new code in {{seconds}} s
signIn.terms: By continuing you agree to the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

points.privateBody: Finders and owners never see each other's email until both agree.
points.proofBody: Hidden questions and proof stop anyone else from claiming your things.
points.localBody: You see items, maps and guidance for the country you live in.

signIn.unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

country.title: Which country do you live in?
country.body: You'll see and claim items only in this country. You can change it later if you move.
country.liveBody: Share your live location. Your country is set from it, and you'll see and claim items only there.

city.title: Which city are you in?
city.body: We use it to show items near you. Only cities in {{country}} are listed.
city.search: Search for your city or town
city.homeBody: Tap the map to set the area you want “near me” to use. Nobody else can see it.
city.locationDenied: We couldn't get your location. Tap the map instead.

language.title: Choose your language
language.body: English is selected. You can switch any time with the globe icon.
language.nameHint: Shown to people you exchange items with. No phone numbers or emails.

home.returnedCount_one: {{count}} item returned to its owner in {{country}}
home.returnedCount_other: {{count}} items returned to their owners in {{country}}
home.waitingCount_one: {{count}} found item is waiting for its owner
home.waitingCount_other: {{count}} found items are waiting for their owners
home.comingTitle: Posting and searching open in the next update
home.comingBody: Your profile is ready. As soon as posting opens, you'll be able to report what you found or lost in {{country}}.
home.foundHint: Post it and help the owner get it back
home.lostHint: Report it and get notified of matches
home.nearEmpty: Nothing found near you yet. Report what you lost to be alerted when it turns up.

next.new: Sign in with a verified email to start posting and claiming.
next.identity_verified: Return items to become a Trusted returner.
next.trusted_returner: Thank you for helping people get their things back.
next.email_verified: Return items to become a Trusted returner.

settings.title: Settings
settings.changeCountryBody: Only change this if you have moved. You'll see items in the new country only, your city is updated from your live location there, and you can't change it again for 30 days.
settings.changeCountryCooldown: You can change your country again on {{date}}.
settings.privacyBody: We keep only what's needed to return items. ID numbers, serial numbers and hidden answers are encrypted.
settings.deleteBody: Your profile, email address and open posts are removed. This can't be undone. Type DELETE to confirm.
settings.changeCountryLive: Your new country is set from your live location, so share it from the country you now live in.

notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped.

browse.title: Found items in {{country}}
browse.empty: No found items match these filters.
browse.mapNote: Circles show an approximate area (about 500 m), never the exact spot.

item.illustrationNote: For privacy, photos of IDs, cards, documents and cash are never shown publicly.
item.facesBlurred: Location data was removed from these photos.

location.shop_office: Left at a shop or office

item.noReward: The finder doesn't want a reward
item.closeBody: Close it if the item went back to its owner some other way, or you handed it to the authorities. Open claims will be declined.
item.mapNote: This is an approximate area. The exact spot is never shown.

photos.hint: Up to {{max}} photos. Location data is removed automatically.

foundWizard.title: I found something
foundWizard.photosPublic: Clear photos help the owner recognise it. Location data is removed from every photo.
foundWizard.photosPrivate: Photos of IDs, cards, documents and cash stay private: only you and moderators see them. Others see an illustration.
foundWizard.describeBody: Keep it short and leave out anything that would let a stranger claim it, like names, numbers or exact contents.
foundWizard.descriptionHint: No phone numbers, emails, links or ID numbers.
foundWizard.questionsTitle: Hidden questions only the owner can answer
foundWizard.questionsBody: Add 2 to 4 questions with the answers. They are encrypted and never shown publicly; you'll compare a claimant's answers with yours.
foundWizard.question: Question {{n}}
foundWizard.identifierSerial: Serial number, IMEI or card number (private)
foundWizard.identifierHint: Never shown to anyone. FoundBack compares it with the number the owner enters.
foundWizard.whereBody: Tap the map to drop a pin. It must be inside {{country}}.
foundWizard.wherePrivacy: Others only see an approximate area of about 500 m around this point.
foundWizard.whereNote: Name of the police station, shop or office
foundWizard.accept: I have read the guidance above and my post has no personal details.

lostWizard.title: I lost something
lostWizard.travelToggle: I lost it while travelling in {{country}}
lostWizard.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Grey backpack with a NASA patch
lostWizard.descriptionHint: Colour, brand, size and anything distinctive. No phone numbers or emails.
lostWizard.identifierHint: Kept private and encrypted. Used to spot an exact match.
lostWizard.privateHint: Only you can see these, e.g. receipt details. They help you prove ownership later.
lostWizard.whereBody: Tap the map inside {{country}}, then set how far it could be.
lostWizard.whenBody: Give the time window when it went missing.
lostWizard.photosBody: Photos of the item, the box or a receipt. They stay private.

my.title: My items
my.foundEmpty: You haven't posted any found items.
my.noMatches: No matches yet. We'll notify you when something similar is found.

alerts.title: Saved alerts
alerts.body: Get notified when a matching item is found near a place.
alerts.create: Notify me if it's found nearby
alerts.keywordsHint: All words must appear in the found item's description, e.g. "black".

claim.title: Claim this item
claim.questionsBody: Only the finder sees your answers.

proofHelp.id: Enter the {{idName}} number (we compare it automatically and never show it) and add a selfie holding another ID.
proofHelp.device: Enter the IMEI or serial number, or add a photo of the box or receipt.
proofHelp.other: Describe the item in detail or add photos that show it's yours.

claim.identifierHint: Compared by FoundBack automatically. Never shown to the finder.
claim.selfie: Selfie holding another ID (not the {{idName}} you lost)
claim.text: Anything else that proves it's yours
claim.privacy: Your contact details stay hidden. You'll chat in FoundBack until the finder approves and you both agree to meet.

review.title: Review claims
review.flagged: FoundBack flagged this claim as possibly suspicious. Check the proof carefully.
review.identifierMatch: The number they entered matches the one you saved.
review.identifierMismatch: The number they entered does NOT match the one you saved.
review.question: Question
review.idProvided: They entered an ID number. It's compared automatically and never shown.
review.approveBody: Only one claim can be approved; any others will be declined. Next you'll both agree on a safe handover.

claimDetail.pendingNote: The finder has until {{date}} to respond.
claimDetail.rejected: The finder couldn't confirm this claim.

messages.title: Messages
messages.masked: Phone numbers, emails and links are hidden automatically.
messages.empty: No conversations yet. They start when someone claims an item.
messages.safety: Never send money in advance. Meet only in a safe public place.
messages.start: Say hello. Contact details are hidden until you both agree.

handover.title: Handover: {{category}}
handover.agreeBodyFinder: You approved this claim. Confirm you're ready to hand the item over.
handover.agreeBodyOwner: Your claim was approved. Confirm you're ready to collect the item.
handover.waitingOther: Waiting for the other person to agree.
handover.codeBody: Show this code or QR to the finder when you receive the item.
handover.codeWarning: Only share it in person, once you have the item in your hands.
handover.enterBody: Ask the owner for their 6-digit code when you hand the item over, or scan their QR.
handover.scanUnsupported: QR scanning isn't supported on this browser. Type the code instead.
handover.cameraDenied: We couldn't open the camera. Type the code instead.
handover.method: How will it be handed over?

methods.meet: Meet in a safe public place
methods.collect: Collect from where the finder left it

methodHelp.meet: Pick a police station, bank, mall or station near you both.
methodHelp.courier: Arrange the courier in the chat. The owner pays.

handover.noPlaces: No safe places found nearby. Agree on one in the chat.
handover.otherShares: The other person agreed to share theirs.
handover.otherNotShares: Emails are shown only if you both agree.
handover.courierNote: Never pay for an item. FoundBack never asks for money.
handover.rewardHint: Only for your records. FoundBack doesn't handle payments.
handover.shareStory: Share my note as a success story in my country (no names or contact details)

match_for_owner.title: Possible match found
match_for_owner.body: A found {{category}} may be yours ({{score}}% match).

match_for_finder.title: Someone may have lost this
match_for_finder.body: A lost report matches the {{category}} you found ({{score}}% match).

alert_match.title: Your alert: {{category}} found
alert_match.body: A {{category}} was found near the area you're watching.

new_claim.title: New claim on your post
new_claim.body: Someone says the {{category}} you found is theirs. Review their proof.

claim_approved.title: Your claim was approved
claim_approved.body: Agree on a safe handover for the {{category}}.

claim_rejected.title: Your claim was not approved
claim_rejected.body: The finder couldn't confirm your claim for the {{category}}.

claim_follow_up.title: The finder has a question
claim_follow_up.body: Answer a follow-up question about the {{category}}.

follow_up_answered.title: Follow-up answered
follow_up_answered.body: The claimant answered your question about the {{category}}.

claim_expired.title: Claim expired
claim_expired.body: Your claim for the {{category}} expired without a response.

new_message.title: New message
new_message.body: You have a new message about the {{category}}.

handover_ready.title: Handover agreed
handover_ready.body: You both agreed. Choose how to hand over the {{category}}.

handover_updated.title: Handover plan changed
handover_updated.body: The handover plan for the {{category}} was updated.

handover_reminder.title: Handover reminder
handover_reminder.body: Your handover for the {{category}} is coming up. Meet only in a safe public place.

item_returned.title: Returned!
item_returned.body: The {{category}} is back with its owner. Please rate the handover.

found_reminder.title: Still holding a found item?
found_reminder.body: Your {{category}} post has been open for 90 days. Consider handing it to {{authority}}.

identity_approved.title: Identity verified
identity_approved.body: You now have the Identity verified badge.

identity_rejected.title: Identity check not approved
identity_rejected.body: We couldn't verify your identity. You can try again.

report.title: Report a problem
report.thanks: Thanks. A moderator for your country will review it.

travel.title: Travel mode
travel.body: Lost something abroad? For 30 days you can report lost items in one other country. Those reports only match items there and are marked "Traveller".
travel.locationNote: You need to be in that country now: we'll check your live location.

identity.title: Identity verification (optional)
identity.body: Get the Identity verified badge: enter your {{idName}} number and take a selfie holding it. An admin reviews it; the number is encrypted and never shown.
identity.privacy: Stored encrypted and only used for this check.
identity.pending: Your identity check is waiting for review.
identity.rejected: Your identity check was not approved.

admin.title: Admin
admin.identityNote: Compare the face with the ID in the selfie. The ID number itself is never shown.
admin.searchUsers: Search by name or user ID
admin.name: Name
admin.moderatorsHelp: Paste the user ID (from the Users tab) and the countries they will moderate.
admin.translationsHelp: Share of interface text translated in each language. Missing text shows in English.

location.title: Share your live location
location.body: FoundBack decides your country from your device's GPS, so everyone acts only where they really are. A VPN can't change it.
location.privacy: Only your country is used. Your exact position is never shown to anyone.

errors.denied: Location access is blocked. Allow location for this site in your browser or phone settings, then try again.
errors.unavailable: We couldn't get your location. Turn on GPS / Location services and try again.
errors.timeout: Getting your location took too long. Try again, ideally near a window or outdoors.
errors.unsupported: This browser can't share your location. Try Chrome or Safari on your phone.

location.chooseBody: We couldn't get your location or tell where your connection is. Choose the country you're in now.

system.maintenanceBody: FoundBack is being updated. Please check back soon.
system.registrationClosed: New sign-ups are paused right now. Existing members can still sign in.

staff.title: Staff sign-in
staff.note: For FoundBack admins and moderators. 5 wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes.
staff.userSignIn: Not staff? Sign in with Google or email

adminSettings.intro: Changes apply to the website and the installed app within a few minutes, with no redeploy. Keys are stored encrypted and are never shown again in full.
adminSettings.replace: Paste a new key to replace it
adminSettings.willClear: Will be removed when you save.

groupHelp.general: Maintenance, announcements and sign-ups for the whole app.
groupHelp.features: Switch features on or off for everyone.
groupHelp.security: How strictly location and staff sign-in are enforced.
groupHelp.limits: Daily limits and time windows that protect against abuse.
groupHelp.email: Used for notifications and staff sign-in codes. User sign-in emails (verification, password reset) are sent by Firebase.
groupHelp.signin: From Firebase console → Project settings → General → Your apps → Web app config. Also enable Google and Email/Password under Authentication → Sign-in method, and add your website under Authorised domains.
groupHelp.ai: Translation of posts and chat, and photo moderation. Providers are tried in order until one answers.
groupHelp.location: Optional: lets the VPN check work everywhere by looking up the country of each IP address.
groupHelp.push: Changing these keys signs every device out of push notifications.
groupHelp.storage: Changing these moves new uploads to another bucket; existing photos stay where they are.

keys.maintenance_mode: Maintenance mode (app shows a notice; only admins can use it)
keys.max_posts_per_day: Found posts per person per day
keys.max_lost_reports_per_day: Lost reports per person per day
keys.ipinfo_token: ipinfo.io token (IP country for VPN check)
keys.google_client_id: Google client ID (for the Sign in with Google button)

adminSettings.passwordRules: At least 10 characters with upper- and lower-case letters, a number and a symbol.
adminSettings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.

firebase.resetBody: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
firebase.resetSent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.
firebase.verifyBody: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your address, then come back here. Check your spam folder if you don't see it.
firebase.verificationResent: A new link is on its way.
firebase.wrongPassword: Email or password is not correct.
firebase.emailInUse: An account already exists for this email. Sign in instead, or use Google if you signed up with it.
firebase.weakPassword: Use a password with at least 8 characters.
firebase.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
firebase.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the Google window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
firebase.unauthorizedDomain: This website address isn't allowed to sign in yet. An admin needs to add it in Firebase → Authentication → Settings → Authorised domains.
firebase.notEnabled: This sign-in method isn't turned on yet. Please use another one.
firebase.differentMethod: This email already uses a different sign-in method. Try Google or email and password.
